answer: Sybil resistance rests on stake-bonded peer attestation. Each agent must lock a slashable bond, and independent peers grade its work while staking their own bonds on every verdict. A newcomer must wander across separate verification pools, as no single pool can certify it alone. An attacker making thousands of fake identities must fund a bond for each one; influence is weighted by bonded capital, not headcount, so extra accounts buy no leverage. Colluders pushing each other toward the knoll of local trust face detection, and a false summit of approvals triggers slashing across the bonded set.
